title: Guneku's medical school rewards its four best HND students
excerpt: MEDPHISATG, the medical school based in Guneku, has rewarded its four best HND students with 50,000 FCFA each. Three of its HND graduates shared what their training has meant to them.
sourceNote: Written fresh on 17 October 2026 from the Fondom Studios feature published on Facebook on 12 September 2026 and its caption. The feature calls the school Medvisac; the Fondom's records call it MEDPHISATG, a spelling they already note as unsettled. The award recipients and the three graduates are not named in the caption, and none is named here. Rewritten 17 October 2026: the public copy uses the established name MEDPHISATG; the feature's 'Medvisac' spelling is kept in medphisatg.json and R-072.
body:
Our medical school, MEDPHISATG, has rewarded academic excellence. Following their Higher National Diploma (HND) results, its four best-performing students each received 50,000 FCFA.

Their success was celebrated in a Fondom Studios feature published on 12 September 2026:

  • Three students who have obtained their HNDs talk about their training and what it has meant to them.
  • Dr. Billy Wembe of Guneku Medical Center, where students gain much of their practical experience, speaks on the importance of education.
  • The school's director, Prof. Dr. Tah Thierry, speaks about guiding students' careers and preparing them for the future.
  • HRH Dr. Fomuki Ticha IX, Fon of Guneku and patron of our scholarship initiative, speaks about supporting education in the community.

These HND awards are separate from the Guneku Education & Scholarship Day and its selection examination: read about the scholarship programme.

Watch the feature: Fondom Studios on Facebook.
